records.jp: 眠くなってきた。<CR>そろそろ寝よう……
records.en_original: I'm getting sleepy. I think I'll turn in.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm getting sleepy. I think I'll turn in.
records.en: I'm getting sleepy.<CR>I think I'll turn in.

records.jp: （靭こころ）
records.en_original: (Kokoro Utsubo.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Kokoro Utsubo.)
records.en: (Utsubo Kokoro.)

records.jp: （宮内伶那）
records.en_original: (Rena Miyauchi.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Rena Miyauchi.)
records.en: (Miyauchi Rena.)

records.jp: （金城勇希）
records.en_original: (Yuki Kinjou.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Yuki Kinjou.)
records.en: (Kinjou Yuki.)

records.jp: （もともとこの世界で暮らしてた三人）
records.en_original: (They've been living here since even before I showed up.)
records.en_auxiliary: (They've been living here since even before I showed up.)
records.en: (They've been living here since even before I showed up.)

records.jp: （みんなと出会ってから、もう三日は経ったっけ）
records.en_original: (Has it already been three days since we met?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Has it already been three days since we met?)
records.en: (Has it already been three days since we met?)

records.jp: （結局この世界は、なんなのかな）
records.en_original: (Just what is this world, anyway?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Just what is this world, anyway?)
records.en: (Just what is this world, anyway?)

records.jp: （長い夢だっていうなら、それでいい）
records.en_original: (It could just be a particularly long dream.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It could just be a particularly long dream.)
records.en: (If this is one long dream, that's fine.)

records.jp: （ドッキリでしたっていうなら、<CR>長すぎるけど今なら笑って許そう）
records.en_original: (It could be a prank that's gone on a little too long. I could still laugh this all off I think.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It could be a prank that's gone on a little too long. I could still laugh this all off I think.)
records.en: (If this is a prank, it's gone on far too long,<CR>but if they reveal it now, I'll laugh and forgive them.)

records.jp: （まさか死後の世界なんてことは……<CR>ううん、ないない！）
records.en_original: (Or maybe... This is the afterlife? No, no way!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Or maybe... This is the afterlife? No, no way!)
records.en: (Or maybe... This is the afterlife?<CR>No, no way!)

records.jp: （……こころと伶那さんと勇希が、<CR>私を閉じ込めている可能性）
records.en_original: (It's possible they kidnapped me and are keeping me here...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's possible they kidnapped me and are keeping me here...)
records.en: (...Could Kokoro, Rena-san,<CR>and Yuki be keeping me trapped here?)

records.jp: （それはないよ）
records.en_original: (No, I don't think so.)
records.en_auxiliary: (No, I don't think so.)
records.en: (No, I don't think so.)

records.jp: （だってわかるんだ。<CR>まだ出会って間もないけど）
records.en_original: (I may have not known them long, but I don't think they're capable of that.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I may have not known them long, but I don't think they're capable of that.)
records.en: (I can tell.<CR>Even though we only met a short time ago.)

records.jp: （三人がとても私を気遣ってくれてることくらい）
records.en_original: (They've been so nice to me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (They've been so nice to me.)
records.en: (At least, I can tell how much the three of them care about me.)

records.jp: （お母さん……お父さん……心配してるかな）
records.en_original: (Mom... Dad... Are you worried about me?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Mom... Dad... Are you worried about me?)
records.en: (Mom... Dad... Are you worried about me?)

records.jp: （補習、すっぽかしちゃった。<CR>先生、怒ってるだろうな……）
records.en_original: (I bet my professor's mad I never made it to class...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I bet my professor's mad I never made it to class...)
records.en: (I skipped remedial classes.<CR>My teacher must be furious...)

records.jp: ぐすっ……
records.en_original: *Sniff*
records.en_auxiliary: *Sniff*
records.en: *Sniff*

records.jp: 星崎愛央さん、ね。私は宮内伶那
records.en_original: Ao Hoshizaki, was it? My name is Rena Miyauchi.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao Hoshizaki, was it? My name is Rena Miyauchi.
records.en: Hoshizaki Ao-san, was it? My name is Miyauchi Rena.

records.jp: 金城勇希だよ！　よろしく！
records.en_original: I'm Yuki Kinjou! Nice to meet'cha!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm Yuki Kinjou! Nice to meet'cha!
records.en: I'm Kinjou Yuki! Nice to meet'cha!

records.jp: 一応聞いておくけど、怪しい人じゃないんだよね？
records.en_original: Let's get this out of the way. Can we trust you?
records.en_auxiliary: Let's get this out of the way. Can we trust you?
records.en: Just to be safe, you're not someone suspicious, are you?

records.jp: もちろん！　全然怪しくない！
records.en_original: O-of course! I'm super trustworthy!
records.en_auxiliary: O-of course! I'm super trustworthy!
records.en: Of course! I'm not suspicious at all!

records.jp: あはは、怪しー！
records.en_original: Hahaha, that answer was totally sketchy!
records.en_auxiliary: Hahaha, that answer was totally sketchy!
records.en: Hahaha, that answer was totally sketchy!

records.jp: 怪しくないって！<CR>てか、いろいろ聞きたいんだけど！
records.en_original: No, I swear! I have so much I need to ask you!
records.en_auxiliary: No, I swear! I have so much I need to ask you!
records.en: No, I swear!<CR>I have so much I need to ask you!

records.jp: ここってどこ？　私、どうやってここに来たのかな？
records.en_original: Where are we? And how did I get here?
records.en_auxiliary: Where are we? And how did I get here?
records.en: Where are we? And how did I get here?

records.jp: どこかの島だよね？　船は出てるの？
records.en_original: Is this an island somewhere? Do any ships come through?
records.en_auxiliary: Is this an island somewhere? Do any ships come through?
records.en: Is this an island somewhere? Do any ships come through?

records.jp: あ、あれ？　なんかおかしなこと言った？
records.en_original: H-huh? Did I say something weird?
records.en_auxiliary: H-huh? Did I say something weird?
records.en: H-huh? Did I say something weird?

records.jp: いや……ここがどこかなんて、<CR>考えたこともなかったなって
records.en_original: No, It’s just...we've never considered where this is before.
records.en_auxiliary: No, It’s just...we've never considered where this is before.
records.en: No...<CR>It's just that I'd never even thought about where this place was.

records.jp: でも、確かに水に囲まれてるし……。<CR>ここは島……なのかな？
records.en_original: But it is true that this place is surrounded by water. So, I guess...it is an island?
records.en_auxiliary: But it is true that this place is surrounded by water. So, I guess...it is an island?
records.en: But it is true that this place is surrounded by water.<CR>So, I guess...it is an island?

records.jp: いやいやちょっと待ってって！<CR>なんでわかんないの！？
records.en_original: Wait, wait, what?! How can you not know?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, wait, what?! How can you not know?!
records.en: Wait, wait, what?!<CR>How can you not know?!

records.jp: みんなどうやってここに来たのさ！
records.en_original: How did all of you get here?
records.en_auxiliary: How did all of you get here?
records.en: How did all of you get here?

records.jp: そもそもさー……
records.en_original: Actually...
records.en_auxiliary: Actually...
records.en: Actually...

records.jp: あたしたちって、何でここにいるんだろうね！
records.en_original: Why are we here, I wonder?
records.en_auxiliary: Why are we here, I wonder?
records.en: Why are we here, I wonder?

records.jp: （ここに来た日の夢……か。<CR>眠りが浅いのか、やけに夢を見る）
records.en_original: (That was the day I got here... I've been dreaming a lot lately. Must be because I haven't been sleeping well.)
records.en_auxiliary: (That was the day I got here... I've been dreaming a lot lately. Must be because I haven't been sleeping well.)
records.en: (That was the day I got here... I've been dreaming a lot lately.<CR>Must be because I haven't been sleeping well.)

records.jp: （……ダメだ、眠れそうにないや。屋上にでも行こう）
records.en_original: (Ugh, no way I'm getting back to sleep now. Maybe I'll go up to the roof.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ugh, no way I'm getting back to sleep now. Maybe I'll go up to the roof.)
records.en: (Ugh, no way I'm getting back to sleep now. Maybe I'll go up to the roof.)
